book: A Latin treatise on the forensic laws of the Hebrews, in one work (De legibus Ebraeorum forensibus liber singularis): front matter of dedications and rubrics, then the Codex primus, a commentary on the Mishnah of Bava Kamma in ten chapters with notes, followed by indices of Scripture, matters and Hebrew words.
